subject: Confidential audit request — NDA routing and audit period clarification
messages:
From: security@neobank.com (Elena Park)
To: jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access (NDA required)

Hi Jordan,

I'm Elena Park from Neobank Solutions' security team. We're in the middle of a procurement review for a payments integration and need access to Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report for the 2025 audit period. Our procurement policy requires a countersigned NDA before privileged report delivery.

Two quick clarifications we need before we proceed:
- Audit period: can you confirm the SOC 2 Type II cover period (start/end dates) and if there is a bridge letter available for the period after the report date?
- Delivery: we require the report to be hosted in a gated Drive folder accessible only after NDA execution. DocuSign is preferred for signatures.

I've attached our standard security request document and a short procurement checklist. Can you route the NDA to the right Legal contact and let me know an estimated turnaround?

Appreciate it,

Elena Park
Senior Security Analyst
Neobank Solutions
attachments: Neobank_Security_Request_20261120.eml, procurement_checklist.xlsx
From: jordan.blake@redwood.ai
To: security@neobank.com (Elena Park)
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access (NDA required)

Elena — thanks for the note and the checklist. Looping in Monica (Security) to confirm any technical gating steps. I'll route the NDA to Legal for countersign; Marissa will handle execution and DocuSign routing.

A couple of items from our side to speed this up:
- SOC 2 period: the most recent Type II covers 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31. We do offer a bridge letter for the post-report window — please confirm the target coverage date you need.
- Access model: after NDA countersign, we can place the Type II report and any privileged evidence in a gated Google Drive folder with view-only access and IP-restricted links. We also produce a short SOC 2 summary (non-privileged) that we can share immediately if helpful.

I'll attach our standard NDA for initial review; if Neobank returns a redline we'll route to Legal for quick review. Monica — any additional security-only gating we should apply?

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199
